RWA.note: Training named is for youth, women and farmers, not civil servants.
Two data centres built for the education network; document does not say they rent to others.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Education with the Ministry of ICT and Huawei launched the DigiTruck, a mobile classroom to give free digital skills training to more than 5,000 youth, women and farmers in all 30 districts over three years, part of a goal to train one million citizens.

RWA.note: Two education data centres named; no statement they are for hire or their Tier.
Gives 1,500 schools connected, no share of secondary schools; no compulsory curriculum statement.
